title: rosa × collina var. incerta
intro: Rosa × collina var. incerta, commonly known as Rosa incerta, is a hybrid rose species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Rosa incerta include its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate stress, thanks to its calming and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents present in Rosa incerta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
